name: Wheeling University
academic_ranking: Private university in Wheeling, WV (founded 1954 as Wheeling College; formerly Jesuit until 2019). Small enrollment (~774 students in fall 2024, ~619 undergraduate). Average incoming freshman HS GPA around 3.5; Princeton Review selectivity ~81/100. Accredited by the Higher Learning Commission.
financial_aid: Offers institutional scholarships and need-based aid. Notable named award: the $10,000 Mount de Chantal Scholarship for one incoming female freshman, renewable annually. Athletic scholarships available for D2 softball. Confirm specifics with the WU financial aid office.
facilities_notes: Softball competes as the Wheeling Cardinals. Facility details not confirmed from a live source during this research (softball page checked 2026-07).
program_reputation: NCAA Division II program competing in the Mountain East Conference (MEC), which Wheeling joined as a founding member in 2013-14. Team social account @WheelingU_SB.
notes: Coaching staff and roster captured live from wucardinals.com softball pages on 2026-07. Roster size (27) from the 2026 softball roster page. Tuition left null - no authoritative live figure confirmed without guessing (official tuition page returned 404, College Navigator did not list a figure). Scholarship count not publicly listed.
